title: Listening Drill — Art studio route
description: Directions dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Art studio route
sections.transcript:
VISITOR: I'm trying to get to the figure drawing studio. My map shows two possible routes. Which one would you recommend?

ASSISTANT: Start at the main entrance. From there, walk towards the indoor fountain. Stay on the same side until you can see the sign for the studio wing.

VISITOR: Can I go through the middle? It looks a lot shorter on the map.

ASSISTANT: I'd avoid the central stairs today. A section is closed for repainting. If you're meeting a group, wait by the sign so they can spot you.
